Hi — Fahad here, AI engineer in Dhaka.

I've been researching dental chains in Bangladesh, and Tech Dental Care with 4 branches is a serious operation. The biggest leak in multi-branch dental practices is usually in appointment booking — patients call the hotline, get put on hold, and then need to be routed to the right branch based on their service needs.

Here's what I see: with 4 branches, you need to handle appointment booking, branch routing, and patient follow-up across multiple locations. Right now, that's phone-based, which means your front desk is spending time on scheduling instead of patient experience. And with services ranging from general dentistry to cosmetic procedures, the booking logic isn't simple.

I built an AI dental booking agent that handles WhatsApp enquiries 24/7 — it asks what service they need, recommends the right branch and doctor, shows available slots, and confirms the appointment. It also sends pre-appointment preparation instructions and post-treatment follow-up reminders.

Happy to show you a working demo in 15 minutes. No commitment.

Best,
Fahad
